How do you know an AI agent is ready before a frontline health worker starts relying on its answers?

Our ML team at ARTPARK IISc built Calibrate for exactly this. It's an open-source evaluation tool made for nonprofits, and it's how we test our own agents.

Today, Jigar Doshi (ML Director) and Aman Dalmia (Principal ML Engineer) will demo it live. We're co-hosting the session with the^deltathe^delta as part of Pragati AI for Impact.
With Calibrate, a nonprofit team can:
• Run evaluations without writing code, so program and domain experts judge agent quality themselves
• Build AI judges and check them against expert labels before letting them grade responses automatically
• Test across whichever model or provider they already use

Friday 23 October, 2:30 to 3:30 PM IST, on Zoom. The link is in the^delta's post below.
Building or piloting an AI agent? Join us, and bring your toughest testing question for Jigar and Aman.
